faqs.a:
If at any time there should not be sufficient money or other property in the police
               pension fund to pay to each beneficiary the full amount per month to which such beneficiary
               may be entitled, then and in that event, an equal percentage of such monthly payments
               shall be made to each, until such fund is so replenished as to warrant payment in
               full to each of such beneficiaries.
(Code 1960, § 19-11(G); Code 1981, § 26-78)
